player_prompt.intro:
O Player {player_id} o dulang monwana wa Pig Dice.

Melao:
- Ka turn ya gago, o ka '[roll]' or '[hold]'
- Roll a 2-6: Tsaya go ya total ya gago
- Roll a 1: Senya total ya gago ya turn le fedisa turn
- Hold: Tsaya total ya gago go ya score le fedisa turn
- Wa nna go feta {winning_score} dipono a fenya

Fa o bona turn ya gago, o tla bona dipono tsa gago tsa sekolo le total ya turn.
Araba le '[roll]' go rolla die or '[hold]' go tsaya dipono.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Tsaya tsela e seng sa tshwane. Dirisa '[roll]' or '[hold]'.
